name: Eastern Paladin
description: A paladin with a passion for death who attacks at night and rings his city with a wall of bone.

description_citations.text: Seventh Edition: card flavor text (Seventh Edition, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Eastern Paladin prepares caltrops as a welcome for his rival, the Southern Paladin.
timeline.quote: The Eastern Paladin knew how highly his southern rival valued horses
